questions.q: What is a business's functional currency?
options: The primary currency it uses for its own books and reporting
Whatever currency its largest customer uses
A currency that changes every fiscal year
Always US dollars, regardless of where the business operates
questions.explain: Functional currency is the business's own primary reporting currency, often tied to the currency of an Oracle Fusion ledger.

options: A currency used only for tax filings
The currency a specific transaction actually happens in, which can differ from the functional currency
The currency printed on company letterhead
A currency that no longer exists
questions.explain: Transaction currency is whatever currency a specific deal is conducted in, which may differ from the business's functional currency.

questions.q: Harrowgate Industrial Supply sells EUR 10,000 on June 1 at $1.10/EUR ($11,000 recorded) and collects cash on July 1 at $1.08/EUR ($10,800). What does the $200 difference represent?
options: A sales discount given to the customer
An accounting error that must be corrected
Additional revenue earned from the transaction
A foreign currency loss, caused purely by the exchange rate moving between recording and settlement
questions.explain: The euro amount itself never changed; only its dollar value changed due to the exchange rate shift, producing a foreign currency loss.

questions.q: Why do multi-currency businesses often need multiple Oracle Fusion ledgers or specific multi-currency configuration?
options: Because Oracle Fusion cannot process any foreign currency transactions
Because every country requires its own completely separate accounting software
Because each ledger's functional currency, and the handling of transaction currencies that differ from it, needs to be managed carefully
Because multi-currency accounting has no connection to ledgers at all
questions.explain: Since a ledger's functional currency is fixed, businesses operating in multiple currencies often need multiple ledgers or robust multi-currency configuration.

questions.q: What does Oracle Fusion automate, with respect to the concepts in this lesson?
options: It automatically handles currency conversion and calculates realized and unrealized gains/losses as transactions are recorded and settled
It eliminates the need to ever record foreign currency transactions
It fixes exchange rates permanently so they never change
It only supports transactions in a single global currency
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion automates currency conversion using configured exchange rates and calculates the resulting gains/losses, exactly matching the manual calculation in this lesson.
